authorization.approvalQuestion: Recorded the lantern direction as approved. Shall we generate the matching sprout next?

silhouette-approved family reference; shading and alpha defects expressly excluded

verification.tool: ImageMagick 7.1.2-34 Q16-HDRI; Python 3 standard library for decoded pixel counting
verification.assessment: Clearly recognizable two-leaf sprout at 24px, clearer stem and leaf separation at 32px. Matching cream/gold and softly organic silhouette family, but visually lighter and shorter than the lantern at equal canvas size. Useful pilot, not fully conforming production-ready art.
deviations: 1254x1254 decoded instead of requested and generator-reported 1024x1024
Subtle shading and non-exact palette colors instead of strictly flat fills
Low-alpha edge and surrounding residue persists despite explicit exclusion; most solid-looking artwork is alpha 254, not fully opaque
Main silhouette meets 12.5 percent padding, but low-alpha residue extends into the requested clear safe padding
At equal untrimmed canvas sizes, principal sprout height is 825 source pixels versus lantern height 979; family scale is not normalized
